description: This file contains a PHP class 'Basic' which extends a Controller class within the OpenCart system. It manages the theme extension settings including displaying the configuration page and saving settings via AJAX. The class defines at least two methods: index() for rendering the settings page, and save() for processing updates and returning JSON responses.

classes.name: Basic
classes.description: Controller class for the 'Basic' theme extension, responsible for managing theme settings, displaying the configuration page, and saving settings.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the theme settings page, loads language texts, breadcrumbs, current settings, and outputs the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes AJAX POST request to save theme settings, performs permission checks, updates settings, and returns a JSON response indicating success or error.
